topic: compass/invariant — map host project, never quorum internals
decision: Compass source scanners must produce findings about the host project. Any hardcoded reference to quorum module names (oracle, advisor, jury, council, sentinel, compass, chronicle) in scanner logic is a defect.
key_insight: Compass source scanners must produce findings about the host project. Any hardcoded reference to quorum module names in scanner logic is a defect.
rejected_reason: Generic scanning by default is the only safe assumption; opt-in would mean every consumer gets quorum internals until they configure it
